chunks: And it was narrated from al-Hasan ibn Rashid that he said:
Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, when he fasted, would apply perfume and say, "Perfume is a gift for the fasting person."
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about using perfume while fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a practice of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام during fasting: he would use perfume. It presents fragrance as a fitting and pleasant gift for the fasting person, indicating refined etiquette during acts of worship.
